extensions.claim_text: La Rosa's corporate and franchised brokerage offices are staffed with 2,769 licensed real estate brokers and sales associates as of March 31, 2025.
extensions.source_label: Florida DBPR (Department of Business and Professional Regulation) MyFloridaLicense
extensions.endpoint_or_method: https://www.myfloridalicense.com/wl11.asp — search by Primary Name = 'La Rosa Realty'; filter status=Active; aggregate by license type (sales associate vs broker)
extensions.rationale: Florida is the corporate HQ and the documented majority of offices (Celebration, Kissimmee, Davenport, Jacksonville, Miami, etc.) — FL DBPR should show the lion's share of the 2,769 licensees if the count is real
extensions.expected_observable: count of active sales-associate + broker-associate licenses listing 'La Rosa Realty' or 'La Rosa Realty, LLC' as employing broker
extensions.signal_direction: if FL active-affiliated count is much smaller than the claim's implied FL share, the headline agent count is inflated
